title: Aft Pylon Fairing — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the aft pylon fairing from the pylon with the engine installed, including the maintenance stay sequence and the hinge pin handling that keeps the fairing from swinging when the latches are released.

sections.purpose: This task removes the aft pylon fairing so that the fairing inner face, the interface seal and the drain line behind it become accessible for inspection, cleaning or modification.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the engine installed and shut down, and with the thrust reverser deactivated. The fairing is heavy and unbalanced about its hinge line; it will swing when the latches are released, so the maintenance stay goes on before anything is unlatched. Two persons are needed at the fairing and a third at the platform. Do not do this task in a wind above the limit given in the standard practice.
sections.procedure: 1. Deactivate the thrust reverser and tag the control. WARNING: DO NOT WORK AT THE PYLON WITH THE THRUST REVERSER ACTIVE. 2. Position the access platform under the pylon at zones 431 and 433. 3. Install the fairing maintenance stay and take up the slack. CAUTION: THE FAIRING IS HEAVY AND WILL SWING WHEN THE LATCHES ARE RELEASED. INSTALL THE STAY FIRST. 4. Release the fairing latches in the sequence marked on the fairing, outer pair first. 5. Lower the fairing onto the stay and check that the stay carries the full weight. 6. Disconnect the bonding lead at the hinge and stow it clear. 7. Remove the hinge clevis pins EN169671-8B. Keep them; they are replaced only when the modification requires it. 8. With three persons, lift the fairing clear and put it on the padded trestles with the inner face up. 9. Do a visual check of the fairing skin panel D5450133608027 inner face for scorching, and record the extent and the position of any discoloration. 10. Do a visual check of the lower fairing lug kit ROD165267-21 and the upper doubler JAR270491-60 for heat damage and for elongated fastener holes. 11. Cover the exposed pylon interface.
sections.close_out: Put the removed hinge pins and the bonding lead in the layout tray. Make sure that the pylon interface is covered and that no tool is left in the fairing cavity. Record the removal and any scorching finding in the aircraft technical log, with photographs where the discoloration crosses a fastener line.

type_data.effectivity_note: Auran-powered SLN-30R3 and SLN-34R3 aircraft, pre and post MOD-131340

safety_precautions: Deactivate the thrust reverser and tag the control.
Install the fairing maintenance stay before any latch is released.
Do not work at the pylon in a wind above the standard practice limit.
